model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates sensitivity values across transformer block indices for the model noted in the caption (“DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B”), with each block represented by a single bar colored by quantization setting. The horizontal axis contains the categories as “Block Index,” shown in increasing numerical order from 0 to 27 with labeled ticks at 0, 6, 13, 20, and 27. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels at approximately \(10^{-5}\), \(10^{-4}\), and \(10^{-3}\), spanning roughly from \(10^{-5}\) up to about \(10^{-3}\). A legend in the upper-left maps blue bars to “4-Fbit” and green bars to “2-Fbit.” At block 0 there is a blue (4-Fbit) bar around \(1.5\times10^{-4}\); blocks 1–12 are green (2-Fbit) bars mostly near the low end of the axis, ranging approximately from \(1.0\times10^{-5}\) (e.g., around blocks 4 and 8) up to about \(3.5\times10^{-5}\) (around block 1), with intermediate values such as \(\sim1.1\times10^{-5}\) (block 5), \(\sim1.7\times10^{-5}\) (block 6), and \(\sim3.0\times10^{-5}\) (block 12). Blocks 13 and 14 switch to blue (4-Fbit) at roughly \(\sim5.0\times10^{-5}\) and \(\sim4.0\times10^{-5}\), followed by green (2-Fbit) bars at blocks 15–18 around \(\sim2.7\times10^{-5}\) to \(\sim3.5\times10^{-5}\). From block 19 through 27 the bars are blue (4-Fbit) and generally extend higher on the log scale, with approximate values of \(\sim7\times10^{-5}\) (19), \(\sim3.8\times10^{-5}\) (20), \(\sim4.5\times10^{-5}\) (21), \(\sim6.5\times10^{-5}\) (22), \(\sim1.2\times10^{-4}\) (23), \(\sim1.5\times10^{-4}\) (24), \(\sim1.8\times10^{-4}\) (25), \(\sim4\times10^{-4}\) (26), and a tallest bar at block 27 near \(\sim9\times10^{-4}\) (just below \(10^{-3}\)). The bars are presented as a single series by index (not stacked or grouped), with no additional annotations or special emphasis beyond the color encoding.
model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates per-layer (block) “Sensitivity” values for the model (captioned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B) across transformer block indices, with bars colored by a two-level scheme labeled in the legend as 4‑Fbit (blue) and 2‑Fbit (green). The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Block Index,” running in increasing numeric order from 0 to 27 (with labeled ticks at 0, 6, 13, 20, and 27). The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels shown at approximately 10⁻⁵, 10⁻⁴, and 10⁻³, and the plotted range spanning roughly from just under 10⁻⁵ up to about 10⁻³. Each block index has a single vertical bar whose color indicates whether it is marked as 4‑Fbit (blue) or 2‑Fbit (green): block 0 is blue at roughly 1.5–1.7×10⁻⁴; blocks 1–12 are green with values mostly clustered near 1×10⁻⁵ to 3×10⁻⁵ (e.g., around 3–4×10⁻⁵ at block 1, about 1×10⁻⁵ at blocks 4 and 8, and about 3×10⁻⁵ at block 12); blocks 13–14 are blue at approximately 5–6×10⁻⁵ and 4–5×10⁻⁵; blocks 15–18 are green around ~2.5×10⁻⁵ to ~3.5×10⁻⁵; and blocks 19–27 are blue, starting near ~7×10⁻⁵ at block 19, around ~4–7×10⁻⁵ for blocks 20–22, rising to roughly ~1.2–1.8×10⁻⁴ for blocks 23–25, and reaching the tallest bars at blocks 26 and 27 at approximately ~4×10⁻⁴ and ~9×10⁻⁴ (near 10⁻³), respectively. The bars are not sorted by height; they follow the natural increasing block-index order, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations, or stacked/grouped subcomponents beyond the single-bar-per-index coloring indicated by the legend.
